title.en: The Night the Ghost Got In (James Thurber)

text.en: A strange sound downstairs at night leads a whole family into a comic muddle.

The narrator hears something being trodden on in the house on the night of 17 November 1915. He thinks it is his father, his brother Roy or a burglar, and only later thinks of a ghost. The false alarm causes a hullabaloo of misunderstandings among the family, neighbours and police.
The humour comes from imagination running away with fear. The piece teaches us to look for simple causes before panicking, and it enjoys the funny side of family life and an eccentric grandfather.
Words to learn: hullabaloo, burglar, supposed, suspected and absolute humour. Thurber writes in the first person with a dry, comic tone.
